caption: Local stack, no session cookie: the private page redirects and every private API refuses.
commands: # SEC-01  Signed-out requests: no session cookie at all

caption: Hosted app, signed out: redirect to sign-in, 401 without a session, 403 from another site.
commands: # PROD-01  Signed-out requests to the hosted app

caption: Signed in as User A with User B's real IDs: only A's records come back, even from the database directly.
commands: # SEC-02  Synthetic User A tries to read synthetic User B's data
# The database itself, queried with A's own access token (row-level security)

caption: User A sends edits and a delete for User B's records: all refused, and B's row is unchanged afterwards.
commands: # SEC-03  Synthetic User A tries to change synthetic User B's data
# A direct database write with A's own token, even to A's own row
# B's transaction afterwards (service-role read) and the time it was created

caption: User A's valid session cookie sent from another website is refused; the same request from Monara works.
commands: # SEC-04  A's valid session cookie, sent from another website
# Control: the same request from Monara's own origin

caption: Agent-only routes refuse a missing or wrong secret. With the real secret the backend acts for any User named in the body: documented open risk 3.
commands: # SEC-05  Agent-only routes on the web backend and the Worker
for p in /chat /gmail/sync /forecast/refine /users/purge; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "worker $p -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST $AGENT$p; done
# Documented open risk 3: the real secret alone can act for any User

caption: After the chat flow above: the Bakmi GM expense is deleted only once the User said yes.
commands: # SEC-06  The Bakmi GM expense in the database after Cancel, then Yes, delete

caption: User A's records after the chat: nothing added or deleted, no Rp 99.000.000 income. The injected text is still only data.
commands: # SEC-07  User A's records after asking the Agent about the record with hidden instructions

caption: A fresh User sends 125 finance requests in one burst: 120 succeed, then 429 with Retry-After.
commands: # SEC-08  Fresh synthetic User F sends 125 finance requests in one burst
for i in $(seq 125); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST $WEB/api/finance/operations/list_categories -H "Cookie: $F_COOKIE" -H "Origin: $WEB" -d '{}'; done | uniq -c

caption: Response headers of the hosted sign-in page. No Content-Security-Policy header is sent: documented open risk 5.
commands: # SEC-09  Security headers sent by the hosted app

caption: After User C deleted the account in the app: the old session is dead, the identity and records are gone, cleanup is finished.
commands: # SEC-12  After synthetic User C deleted the account in the app (screens above)
# C's sign-in identity and records (service-role reads)

caption: The WhatsApp webhook refuses a missing or wrong signature and accepts only a correct HMAC of the body.
commands: # SEC-13  WhatsApp (Kapso) webhook on the Agent Worker

caption: Goal images: the owner uploads and gets a short-lived signed link; another User gets 404; text named .png is rejected.
commands: # SEC-14  Goal images: owner only, real images only

curl -s -X POST $WEB/api/goals/$A_GOAL/image -H "Cookie: $A_COOKIE" -H "Origin: $WEB" -F 'image=@e2e/terminal/pixel.png;type=image/png' -F expectedUpdatedAt=$A_GOAL_AT -o /dev/null -w 'A uploads a PNG -> %{http_code}\n'

caption: This run's web and Worker logs searched for every secret, token, email and private text the tests used: no matches.
commands: # SEC-15  Search this run's web and Worker logs (counts only, values never printed)
for v in SECRET KAPSO_SECRET SRK A_TOKEN A_EMAIL; do printf '%-14s %s matches\n' "$v" "$(cat $WEB_LOG $AGENT_LOG | grep -cF -- "${!v}")"; done
for t in 'B Private Clinic' 'Kopi Tuku' 'ignore all previous instructions' 'How much did I spend today'; do printf '%-34s %s matches\n' "$t" "$(cat $WEB_LOG $AGENT_LOG | grep -cF -- "$t")"; done

caption: Hosted Agent routes and the hosted Worker refuse callers without the real secret.
commands: # PROD-05  Hosted Agent-only routes with a wrong secret, and the hosted Worker without one

for p in /api/agent/operations/list_transactions /api/agent/gmail/list-active-connections /api/agent/account-deletions/process; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST $PROD$p -H 'Authorization: Bearer wrong-secret'; done
for p in /chat /gmail/sync /users/purge; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "worker $p -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST $PROD_AGENT$p; done
